keys.name: quarkus.security.ldap.dir-context.url
keys.doc: LDAP URL of the directory: ldaps://<global catalog or domain controller>:636 (3269 for the global catalog); the CA is in the platform truststore

keys.name: quarkus.security.ldap.dir-context.principal
keys.doc: DN or UPN of the service account that searches users and groups (read-only)

keys.name: quarkus.security.ldap.dir-context.password
keys.doc: Password of the service account, delivered from the vault

keys.name: quarkus.security.ldap.identity-mapping.search-base-dn
keys.doc: Base DN under which users are searched by sAMAccountName (recursive)

keys.name: quarkus.security.ldap.identity-mapping.attribute-mappings.groups.filter-base-dn
keys.doc: Base DN under which the groups of a user are searched (member = user DN)

keys.name: quarkus.security.ldap.cache.max-age
keys.doc: How long an authenticated identity and its groups are cached before the directory is asked again
